stemMd: A team of 6 equally productive workers finishes a job in 15 days. How long would 10 such workers take, with no coordination losses?
explanationMd: The job requires 6(15)=90 worker-days. Dividing by 10 workers gives 9 days. The productivity assumption permits inverse proportionality.

distractorRationale.d: Confuses the original workforce with completion time.
distractorRationale.a: Uses direct rather than inverse proportionality.
